question: From identical restored body states and identical feasible hand joint goals, over one 250 ms hold, with --finger-joint-servo on against off: does any finger hinge's actuator command push against its own goal, what force and torque reach the hinge, how far is each hinge from its goal at the end of the hold (bend, extend, side, hold goals; both hands), how often does the whole-finger shared factor bind and which hinge sets it, and how often are the finger_couple tendons at their limits?
sigma_source: measured: root mean square of (latched goal - start angle) over 8 bodies x 44 hinges

readings.name: readings where the 'on' rule's command pushed against the hinge's own goal (gap term larger than speed term, command above 0.02)
readings.meaning: of 228800 hinge readings (one hinge at one physics step); 0 = the command never pushes a hinge away from its goal unless the hinge is turning toward it fast
readings.baseline: the 'off' rule at the same readings: 20110

readings.name: bend goals: body mean of the share of pairs ending nearer the goal under 'on'
readings.meaning: 0.5 = the two rules end equally often nearer; 1 = 'on' nearer on every pair (2580 pairs, 8 bodies; ties within the scatter 0 degrees left out)
readings.baseline: median share of the gap closed in the hold: 'off' 0.324, 'on' 0.382 (0 = never moved, 1 = arrived)
readings.statistical_basis: exact two-sided sign-flip count over the body values of (share - 0.5): 2 of 256, line 12

readings.name: extend goals: body mean of the share of pairs ending nearer the goal under 'on'
readings.meaning: 0.5 = the two rules end equally often nearer; 1 = 'on' nearer on every pair (3166 pairs, 8 bodies; ties within the scatter 0 degrees left out)
readings.baseline: median share of the gap closed in the hold: 'off' 0.387, 'on' 0.511 (0 = never moved, 1 = arrived)
readings.statistical_basis: exact two-sided sign-flip count over the body values of (share - 0.5): 2 of 256, line 12

readings.name: whole-finger shared factor below 0.5 ('off' rule)
readings.meaning: one finger chain at one physics step; 1 = every hinge's demand delivered, below 0.5 = every hinge of the finger received under half its demand; median factor 0.6101

readings.name: whole-finger shared factor below 0.5 ('on' rule)
readings.meaning: one finger chain at one physics step; 1 = every hinge's demand delivered, below 0.5 = every hinge of the finger received under half its demand; median factor 0.5547

readings.name: substep readings whose actuator force or joint torque lacks the command's sign
readings.meaning: 'on' arm, over 457600 hinge readings at 5 ms MuJoCo substeps (force and torque each); 0 = the hinge receives the command's direction

readings.name: run-to-run scatter of the end residual
readings.meaning: largest difference between two runs of the same 'off' arm from the same restored state (0 = the simulation repeats exactly); pairs within it count for neither rule
